## Description {#details}

Reporter to display test results, including operand values and types for failures.

The <code><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/classes/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/test-reporter">test&#95;reporter</a></code> class is responsible for formatting and presenting test results within the µTest++ framework. It provides a comprehensive suite of output operators for a wide range of data types, containers, and comparator expressions, enabling detailed and informative reporting of test outcomes.

For failed tests, the reporter prints the actual values of the operands along with their types, supporting precise diagnostics and efficient debugging. The class supports multiple verbosity levels and colour-coded output to distinguish between successful and failed tests, thereby enhancing the clarity and professionalism of test reports.

The <code><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/classes/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/test-reporter">test&#95;reporter</a></code> also offers methods for reporting the commencement and completion of test cases and suites, as well as for handling pass and fail conditions. Additional features include output stream manipulators, support for exception-related expressions, and configurable formatting options.

All members and methods are defined within the <code><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/namespaces/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus">micro&#95;os&#95;plus::micro&#95;test&#95;plus</a></code> namespace, ensuring clear separation from user code and minimising the risk of naming conflicts.

### begin&#95;test&#95;case() {#ac6d43b057a1be46a895e11c81a9c7cfb}

<MemberDefinition
  prototype={<>void micro&#95;os&#95;plus::micro&#95;test&#95;plus::test&#95;reporter::begin&#95;test&#95;case (const char &#42; name)</>}>
Mark the beginning of a test case.

<ParametersList title="Parameters">
<ParametersListItem name="name">The name of the test case.</ParametersListItem>
</ParametersList>

<SectionUser title="Returns">
Nothing.
</SectionUser>

This method marks the beginning of a test case, setting the internal state to indicate that test output is now within a test case context. If there is pending output and the verbosity level is set to verbose, it ensures that output is properly separated and displayed, adding an empty line if necessary.
